Dulladdhaṁ.g: kusalānubhāvena laddhampi idaṁ manussattaṁ dulladdhaṁ vata me.
me mayā laddhayasaṁ dulladdhaṁ, Buddhabhūtassa Satthuno sakkāraṁ akatattā virādhetvā laddhanti attho.

dullabhan.g: etthāpi cittacāra dassanavasena tassa dassanaṁ devānampi dullabhaṁ alabbhanīyaṁ, devehipi taṁ dassanaṁ na sakkā pāpuṇitunti evamattho gahetabbo.
